name: Moving blocks pushing entities and players
deviations: stuck-entity and piston-base corrections are not modeled
note: Entities pushed out of the space a moving block sweeps through each step (0.01 beyond it, at most 0.51 a tick on each axis); moving blocks collide where they stand; moving slime blocks set the speed along their motion to one block a tick; slime blocks bounce what lands on them at 80%
